chapter: Biagini, Duke and the Shaw band
title: Duke Blue Devils summer job and meeting Les Brown
summary: The 1932 Duke band job, Nick Laney's band in New England, and Les Brown heading to Duke.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: We’re going to get to that, remind me, and I’ll ask you about that. Les Brown, Charlie Barnet? Were these the first let’s say name groups?

Well, go back to 1932. I had dropped out of school, and in North Carolina it was on a quarter system instead of the semester. I dropped out after the second quarter. And around Greensboro I just played with bands. And I think it was in May of that year I got a call from the leader of the Duke University Blue Devils band. They had two bands on the campus there. And this was before Les. And wanted to know if I would do a summer job with them in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, which I did, I took the job. And that band, after the summer job was booked by MCA for three weeks in New England under the Sherman brothers ballrooms. Nick Laney, the star football player at Duke was the leader.
